bootc docs: the composefs backend is supported and under the stability guarantees (every composefs system installed since bootc 1.16.0 is to be upgraded in place); a sealed deployment enforces fs-verity and embeds the expected root digest in a UKI signed for Secure Boot; supported with GRUB (bootupd) or systemd-boot, and sealed UKIs with systemd-boot

bootc docs: the composefs backend has no -boot-complete service and does not configure boot entry counting yet; the docs tell admins to check the previous boot's journal for bootc-finalize-staged failures

bootc security doc: the default /etc/containers/policy.json does not require signatures for generic images, and users should enable them; only composefs with sealed UKIs verifies the mounted root against a signed digest

bootc docs: offline updates work by copying the OS image to an OCI directory (skopeo copy ... oci:), then 'bootc switch --transport oci' and 'bootc upgrade --apply' from a USB drive; the steps can be automated with systemd units, optionally on LUKS media

bootc docs: 'logically bound' app images listed in /usr/lib/bootc/bound-images.d are pulled during bootc upgrade or switch, kept for rollback deployments and garbage-collected by bootc, so a host image pins the exact app images it boots with; Anaconda does not support them
